IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Transportation (originally sponsored by Senators Haugen, Swecker and Murray)

Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing Washington state compliance with the federal REAL ID Act of 2005.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compliance with the federal REAL ID Act of 2005;adding a new section to chapter 43.41 RCW; and adding new sections tochapter 46.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A state agency or program may not expend funds to implement orcomply with the REAL ID Act of 2005, P.L. 10913, unless: (1) Therequirements of section 2 of this act are met; and (2) federal fundsare received by the state of Washington and are (a) allocated to fundthe implementation of the REAL ID Act of 2005 in the state, and (b) inamounts sufficient to cover the costs of the state implementing orcomplying with the REAL ID Act of 2005, as those costs are estimated bythe office of financial management. The director of the office offinancial management shall ensure compliance with this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Before issuing a driver's license or identicard that complies with p. 1 SSB 5087the requirements of the REAL ID Act of 2005, P.L. 10913, and beforestoring or including data about Washington state residents in anydatabase, records facility, or computer system for purposes of meetingthe requirements of the REAL ID Act of 2005, the department oflicensing shall certify that the driver's license, identicard,database, records facility, computer system, and the department'spersonnel screening and training procedures: (1) Include allreasonable security measures to protect the privacy of Washington stateresidents; (2) include all reasonable safeguards to protect againstunauthorized disclosure of data; and (3) do not place unreasonablecosts or recordkeeping burdens on a driver's license or identicardapplicant.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of licensing and the office of financialmanagement may analyze the costs and burdens to the state ofWashington, and to applicants of drivers' licenses or identicards, ofcomplying with the requirements of the REAL ID Act of 2005, P.L. 10913, and any related federal regulations. (2) The attorney general may, with approval of the governor,challenge the legality or constitutionality of the REAL ID Act of 2005.
